mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the Consumer Price Index above 5.0% signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 1.0% and sustained for three months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 1.0% and rising for 3 months), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1.6 million units signals a contraction in the residential sector, a key component of aggregate demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when HOUST < 1600.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime (INDPRO declining for three consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced economic output and potential inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered instances (INDPRO decline for 3 consecutive months), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth rate above 2.5% and unemployment rate below 4.0%), strong economic growth supports corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 2.5% and UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicates a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
